_notes.recordType: BIC-indexed institution directory for stage-3 enrichment (doc 17 B2, Q22). recordType BIC_DIRECTORY is NEW - the canonical spec declares only JP_ENTITY_BANK and IN_BRANCH, both corridor-specific. clearingSystemCode / clearingSystemMemberId are also new fields: the spec's only clearing-member field is `ifsc` (India), yet its own BIAN name is ClearingSystemMemberIdentification, so a generic pair is the correct generalisation and IFSC becomes a special case of it. Awaiting Doina's ratification. DEMO DATA: the two US routing numbers mirror her own wire_domestic sample (debtor 021000021, creditor 121000248 / JPMorgan Chase) so the sample is reproducible end to end; Citibank's is its published NY number. All three carry a valid ABA mod-10 checksum because step 3 validates it. The four non-US member ids are FORMAT-VALID SYNTHETIC values - there is no authoritative sort-code / BLZ table in this workspace, and none is claimed. This is demo reference data, not a Fed routing file.
